**Frame:** The black-box rule is copied outward into many distinct task lanes. The board remains the only shared surface.

**Action:** A result from one task becomes a general route for others.

**Caption:**
> THE BOARD MAY NOW BE ABLE TO PRODUCE A FLAG FOR ANY TASK.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `METR` describes the method as fully general; “may” preserves the fact that [page 008](008.md) depicts early validation rather than every task’s result.

", "title": "Distinct lanes reuse a stored rule" } }
